sourceCache.entry: Private strictly validated JSON bytes keyed by path, content ID and file stat signature.

hydration.behavior: withServerSkills eagerly enumerates all skill definitions; no lazy Proxy remains.
hydration.regression: An unread skill is first accessed by triggerSkill after safeCloneBattleState and executes successfully; nested definitions remain independent.

cloneOptimization.scope: Only ordinary JSON skillsById trees at the original stringify traversal position.
cloneOptimization.behavior: Descriptor-based recursive copies retain every definition, keys, unknown fields and independent mutable objects; large immutable strings can be reused.
cloneOptimization.fallback: Unsupported values remain on the same original JSON.stringify traversal, without retrying getters or toJSON.
cloneOptimization.boundary: Arbitrary JavaScript Proxy traps are not part of file-backed JSON content; no general Proxy equivalence is claimed.

validation.authority: 100 contiguous transitions pass unchanged p95 < 100ms requirement.

withdrawnApproach.name: Lazy skill projection
withdrawnApproach.status: Reverted after independent review found that JSON cloning could omit unread passive triggered skills. Its earlier passing performance figures are not evidence for the final implementation.
